title: Fairground shooting gallery booth
what: A carnival booth: a grey diamond-quilted cabinet with dark pilasters at both ends, a waist-high counter at the front and two stepped shelves behind it, the lower carrying coloured clay jugs and the upper a row of drinking glasses, a robed attendant behind the counter, balloons tied above. First second: the rows of glassware waiting to be shot, the balloons.
recipe: Booth floor s69 is 2304 x 1024 units (3.9 x 1.7 m) at the midway's level; behind it shelf s68 (2304 x 256, 0.66 bodies up) holds 5 jugs (tile 712, owner: clay jug) and shelf s67 (2304 x 256, 1.15 bodies up) holds 6 glasses (tile 574, owner: drinking glass); the back s66 (2816 x 2048) stands 1.93 bodies up with 4 lamp sprites 1115. Glass-like sprites 589 (type 62) x6 also sit on s69. Shelf walls 299, sides 369. The midway around it (s320, 18432 x 11520) is boardwalk floor 250 under a parallax sky.
use: One booth on a fairground lot behind the city's edge facade, or a single booth set into a street wall. The player shoots out the glassware for fun (glass and jug sprites break), and a prize -- ammo or a key -- sits on the top shelf.
